메모: 6번 연말 빈방 「솜채」 — 시댄스 2.5 1일 무제한 웹 판 지시문(2026-10-31). 시작 그림은 확정 이미지 콘티를 16:9 · 1920×1080으로 자른 git 밖 콘티/p6/컷(21은 원본 크기로 맞춰 자른 판 — 정지컷/은 자르기 전이라 쓰지 않음). 동작은 02_콘티 2절 한 가지와 원본 프레임에서 잰 사건 시각, 카메라는 02_콘티 7-1절(원본 실측) 숫자 그대로 — 1~18 · 22 고정(긍정 문구), 19 다가감 · 20 옆 이동 · 21 기욺 → 팬. 두 샷 묶음 없음(붙은 컷마다 해 · 빛 · 카메라 자리가 바뀜). 22는 8.31초라 사건을 8초 판 안으로 당겨 씀(생성기 머리 주석). 입이 보이는 대사 둘(7 엄마 · 11 딸)은 「목소리판」 두 줄 → 견본 → B 판(소리 켬, 10-29 결정), 나머지 말 · 속말 · 끝 문구 · 브랜드 이름은 후반이라 소리 끔. 생성기는 ../시댄스지시문.py, 꾸러미는 ../../../시댄스무제한/웹꾸러미.py.

공통.보기: LOOK: a quiet, tender cinematic family film — cinema camera, soft natural light, fine film grain, natural textures, true-to-life colors. Each shot keeps its first frame's light — direction, color, white balance, exposure and darkness — exactly to the very end: no brightening, no flicker; night stays night. No new text, letters, numbers, logos or signs anywhere; any poster, photo frame or book keeps exactly the picture it has in the first frame. Never add a person or an animal who is not in the first frame, and nobody looks straight into the lens. Every object keeps exactly the shape, size and place it has in the first frame unless the ACTION moves it.
공통.소리: SOUND: silent clip — no dialogue, no narration, no music.

목소리판.동작: The mother, sitting on the bamboo mat to the right of the closed door with her mouth open, closes her mouth and settles down in silence, sitting comfortably; then, still turned toward the door, she says in Korean, in her own natural everyday speaking voice — relaxed and conversational, as if chatting with her daughter through the door; not shouting, not crying, not whispering, not announcing:
목소리판.글: 냉장고에 수박 썰어 놨어. 공부하다 출출하면 나와서 먹어.
목소리판.입: Her lips clearly form the Korean words.

판.설명: 아침 거실 고정 와이드 — 교복 딸(뒷모습)이 문으로 걸어가 1.8초에 문을 열고 들어가 4.2초에 닫음

샷.동작: The schoolgirl walks straight away from the camera toward the closed bedroom door in the middle of the far wall, getting smaller as she goes. At about 1.8 s she reaches the door, turns the round brass knob and pushes the door open into her room; at about 2.4 s she steps through the doorway, and from about 3.4 s she pulls the door shut behind her from inside — it closes completely at about 4.2 s. Then the living room stays empty and still, the door shut, with nothing written on it. She never turns around.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the door, the walls and the furniture never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no drift, no shake; only the people move.

샷.동작: In the first frame the mother sits on the bamboo mat to the right of the closed door, propped back on one hand, her head turned toward the door, her mouth still open from a call she has just finished. She closes her mouth at once and waits in silence, listening for an answer that does not come — she makes no sound before 1.4 s. By about 1.2 s she pushes herself upright and leans toward the door on both hands, facing the door, and she shouts at it in Korean — from about 1.4 s to 3.6 s: "문 잠그고 뭐 해, 또 자?" — then, sharper, from about 3.6 s: "수능이 코앞이야!" — her lips clearly forming the Korean words and her shoulders jerking forward with each call. After the second line she stays leaning toward the door, catching her breath, and says nothing more. The standing fan's blades keep spinning; the door stays shut.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the door, the walls and the furniture never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no drift, no shake; only the people move.

소리줄.켬: SOUND: only her voice shouting these two Korean lines at the door, over quiet room tone — no fan noise, no insects, no music, no narration, no other voices, no sound effects.

판.설명: 흐린 낮 고정 와이드 — 문간의 딸이 엄마에게 쏘아붙이고(딸 목소리 B, 0.0~2.4초) 들어가 문을 닫음(3.4초), 엄마는 소리 없이 문 쪽으로(엄마 대답은 후반)

샷.동작: The bedroom door stands open. In the doorway the daughter faces her mother and, from the very start to about 2.4 s, snaps at her in Korean with one sharp gesture of her hand: "내일 면접인데, 들어오지 말랬잖아!" — her lips clearly forming the Korean words. Then she steps back into her room and swings the door shut — it is fully closed by about 3.4 s, and the dry-cleaning bag hooked over the top of the door swings in with it. The mother stays standing just left of the door, mostly turned away from the camera, and makes no sound: from about 2.4 s, as the door swings shut in front of her, she only turns to face it and lifts one hand a little, helpless, her lips closed, and keeps standing there after it has closed.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the door, the walls and the furniture never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no drift, no shake; only the people move.

소리줄.켬: SOUND: only the daughter's voice snapping this one Korean line, then the soft thud of the door shutting and the rustle of the dry-cleaning bag, over quiet room tone — no music, no narration, no other voices; the mother makes no sound.

판.설명: 문 앞 엄마 뒷모습 미디엄 — 카메라가 몸째 다가감(3초 약 5~8%), 0.4초에 손잡이를 돌려 문을 천천히 엶

샷.동작: The mother stands with her back to the camera at the closed bedroom door, her right hand on the round brass knob. At about 0.4 s she turns the knob and slowly pushes the door open into the room — it swings away from her hand, so the gap opens at the right edge of the door, beside her hand — leaning her head and shoulders toward the widening gap; by about 3.0 s it stands open about a forearm's length, a quarter open, and a strip of the room's pale daylight shows in the gap. Her face stays turned away from the camera — at most the edge of her cheek shows.
샷.카메라: the camera physically moves forward toward her back at one steady speed from the very first frame to the last — the far wall and the door ahead grow by about 5% and the nearer door frame by about 6–8% over the first 3 seconds, heading toward a point slightly left of and below the frame center (44% across, 64% down), and it keeps that same steady forward speed to the end. Perfectly smooth, no shake, no pan, no tilt, no zoom; focus stays on her.

판.설명: 빈방 — 카메라 오른쪽 옆 이동(초당 약 4%, 앞 책상이 더 빨리 지나감), 새 겨울 이불 · 창밖 눈

샷.동작: The daughter's empty bedroom, exactly as in the first frame. Nobody is in the room and nothing in it moves — only the snow keeps falling softly outside the window.
샷.카메라: the camera glides sideways to the right at one steady speed from the very first frame to the last, like a slider — the room slides to the left by about 8% of the frame width over the first 2.2 seconds (about 4% per second) and keeps sliding at that same speed to the end; the desk and chair in the foreground pass slightly faster than the bed and the window behind them. Perfectly smooth, no pan, no tilt, no zoom; everything in the room stays sharp.

판.설명: 엄마 옆얼굴 클로즈업(왼 어깨 뒤) — 아래로 기욺(2.5초에 4%) → 2.1초부터 오른쪽 팬(5.4초에 4.4%), 입 다묾(속말은 후반)

샷.동작: A close-up of the mother from just behind her left shoulder; she looks down to the left, into her daughter's empty room. Over the whole shot her head turns very slowly, only a few degrees, to her left — toward the camera side, never toward the lens — as her eyes travel across the empty room, so that by the last frame a little more of her face shows, three-quarters from behind. Slow breathing, one slow blink at about 2.5 s, her eyes a little moist with a faint wistful softening — no tears running, no smile. Her lips stay closed the whole time; she never speaks.
샷.카메라: smooth and slow, never shaky, no zoom. From the first frame it tilts down a little, following her lowered gaze — the picture moves up by about 4% of the frame height by 2.5 s, slowing to a stop. From about 2.1 s to the very last frame it pans slowly to the right — the picture slides left by about 4.4% of the frame width by 5.4 s, so her face drifts a little toward the left edge — easing in, then keeping a steady pace until the last frame. Shallow depth of field: focus stays on her hair and face; the room behind her stays softly blurred the whole time.

판.설명: 문틈 너머 고정 — 0.5초 안에 앉아 2초 이불 · 4초 거울 쪽을 둘러보다 6.0초에 문 · 복도 쪽으로 고개 듦(렌즈는 안 봄) · 8.31초 컷을 8초 판에(Fable B — 편집: 판 0초 = 51.68초, 고개 듦 58.4초 안팎, 끝 0.31초는 끝 장 이음). 카드 상한이 10초 이상이면 길이 10 · 고개 듦 6.6초로 바꿔 꾸러미를 다시 만든다(Fable A — 편집은 판 0 = 51.68초, 8.31에서 자름) — 생성기 CARD_MAX. 고개 듦이 늦어 판 밖이면 받은 끝 장으로 22b(앉은 엄마 · 1.0초에 고개 듦 · 4초)

샷.동작: Seen from the hallway through the narrow gap of the half-open bedroom door, the mother, bent forward at the edge of the bed, finishes sitting down within the first 0.5 s. Then she rests one hand on her knee and the other on the new blanket and quietly looks around the room — by about 2 s she is looking down at the blanket, by about 4 s over toward the mirror and the desk — her hair half over her face. At about 6.0 s she slowly lifts her head and turns her face toward the open door and the hallway beyond it, as if she just heard the front door open — her eyes on the hallway, never on the camera — and holds that look, lips closed, without moving, to the last frame. She stays small in the door gap.
샷.카메라: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the hallway walls, the door frame and the half-open door never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no drift, no shake; only she moves.
